_comment: Tesla Tools Suite Configuration - Copy this file to 'config.json' or 'Tessie/config.json' and customize your local paths. If external_drive_path is null/omitted, drives matching /Volumes/TESLADRIVE* are auto-discovered. evnex_username/evnex_password are your normal Evnex app login (email + password) for the community-maintained `evnex` python library (https://github.com/hardbyte/python-evnex), which talks to Evnex's own consumer app API - Evnex only issues real API keys to Enterprise/CP-Link customers. Prefer the EVNEX_CLIENT_USERNAME/EVNEX_CLIENT_PASSWORD env vars over config.json if you'd rather not keep the password on disk at all.
